VEA.EdgeAttenuationHint: Controls how gradually vision fades into darkness at its maximum range.
VEA.LightEdgeAttenuationHint: Controls how gradually this light fades at its maximum range, independently of its native attenuation.
VEA.VisionOverrideHint: When enabled, this token's vision attenuation overrides the world default.
VEA.LightOverrideHint: When enabled, this light's attenuation overrides the world default.
VEA.Measurement.ButtonHint: Hold to temporarily remove this token's vision edge attenuation for measurement.
VEA.Settings.MenuHint: Set world defaults, Fog of War attenuation, and the player measurement control.
VEA.Settings.Intro: World defaults affect every eligible vision and light source unless that source uses a custom value.
VEA.Settings.VisionDefaultHint: Applied to token vision unless the token uses a custom value.
VEA.Settings.LightDefaultHint: Applied to token and ambient lights unless the light uses a custom value.
VEA.Settings.FogAttenuationHint: Softens the visual edge between explored and unexplored Fog of War. It does not change exploration data or visibility rules.
VEA.Settings.PlayerMeasurement: Enable the measurement button for players
VEA.Settings.PlayerMeasurementHint: Adds a hold-to-measure button to an owned token's HUD. It temporarily shows that token's vision with no edge attenuation.
VEA.LightUnsupported: Vision Edge Attenuation: an incompatible light shader was detected. That source keeps its native lighting; see the console.
VEA.Unsupported: Vision Edge Attenuation: the visual effect is unavailable with this canvas pipeline. Token settings are preserved; see the console and README.
VEA.PersistentVision: Vision Edge Attenuation: persistent vision does not distinguish current sight from exploration. Vision edge attenuation is disabled for this scene.
